'''Eyar City''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] with an extensive [[Eyar City Sewer|sewer system]]. [[Eyar Treatment Systems]] cleaned and maintained the underground sewers of the city, but they were still often left unclean because the city's government underfunded them.<ref name="HS" />

The city shared its name with the [[Eyar system/Legends|Eyar system]].
